title: Annual Maintenance of Government Office Buildings

clauses.text: This tender invites sealed bids for the annual maintenance of government office buildings, covering civil repairs, painting and minor electrical works.
Contractors registered in Class-A, Class-B or Class-C are eligible to bid.
The bidder must have an annual turnover of at least ₹5 crore.
The bidder must have at least 3 years of experience in building maintenance works.
Bids must be submitted within 30 days from the date of publication of this notice.
An Earnest Money Deposit of 2% of the estimated contract value must accompany the bid.
The contract period shall be 24 months from the date of award, with work orders issued as required.
